concept.title: What does it mean to "Trial" an Event?
concept.shortdesc: Often times events are said to be trialed, but what does this actually mean?

conbody.p: Sometimes events are trial events from the start. This means that the Science Olympiad organization is testing these events out to maybe bring them into rotation for future seasons, or the tournament organizers wanted to bring an old event back for fun. Either way, these events do not count toward a team's overall score. When an event is "trialed", this means that either something went wrong with how the test was ran or how it was graded, so now it no longer counts toward a team's score. This way, teams get to still see how they would have placed, but it does not affect their final standing.
